'''Cloudside Resorts''' was a resort located on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=message|Alone time|[[Vette]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Cloudside Resorts are mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in a letter the player receives from [[Vette]] if they have romanced her.<ref name="TOR" />
